snippet.title: Corey Coldbrew platform game for Spectrum computers
snippet.description:
Written with the Multi-Platform Arcade Game Designer, Blue Bilby brings you "Corey Coolbrew".
Coming soon to your Spectrum.
30 levels of awesome platforming fun!
Spectrum 128s with the AY sound chip have a rocking, boppy tune by Mike Richmond.
Can you help Corey escape the robot laboratory and live to see another day?
